name: Solid Bamboo Slats, Natural, Black Felt
summary: Solid bamboo slats in Natural, a soft blonde tone, sealed with a matte protective lacquer and backed with recycled black acoustic felt.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec sheet takes precedence over photo estimates: eight 1.00 in solid bamboo slats with 0.51 in square-profile felt gaps on a 1.51 in pitch, 0.51 in slat thickness over 0.35 in felt and 0.87 in specified total depth; tile covers eight pitches (12.08 in, versus the rounded 12.09 in installed panel width). Natural blonde bamboo tones are sampled from the main listing photo, with procedural vertical grain, recycled black felt and a non-gloss protective lacquer finish.
